intro.h2: A siding replacement and home repair contractor who explains the fix
paragraphs: Houser Construction Company LLC is a general contractor led by Andrew Houser. We handle siding replacement and home repair, from swapping out old siding to rebuilding the rotted sheathing and framing hidden behind it. We also build decks, install attic stairs and clear out old cabinets ahead of a remodel.

Customers keep coming back to the same three things. Andrew explains in detail what needs to be done, so you understand the repair before you pay for it. He shows up fast when something goes wrong: one homeowner had him there the next day after masons uncovered rot under a front stoop. And he cleans up everything before he leaves.

services.h2: Siding replacement and home repair services

items.name: Siding replacement
items.blurb: Old or damaged siding comes off and new siding goes on, with the trim and edges finished cleanly. Siding replacement is one of the jobs our customers mention most, and one family who had their house re-sided says the work was completed on time with great attention to detail.

image.alt: Rear of a two-story house with blue siding and white trim above a new wood deck

items.name: Rot, sheathing and framing repair
items.blurb: When rot turns up behind siding or under a stoop, we replace the damaged siding, sheathing and framing. On one emergency call Andrew was there the next day, explained the repair in detail and took extra measures so the damage would not come back.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a freshly repaired front entry wall of a Northeastern American suburban home: new navy blue vinyl siding and crisp white trim around a front door, a new concrete stoop with brick edging, clean and finished, no sign of damage, evergreen shrubs, soft overcast daylight, navy, white and warm wood palette, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Front entry of a house with new navy siding, white trim and a new concrete stoop

items.name: Deck building
items.blurb: Our Google photos show decks we have built, from a sunny pressure-treated platform with white posts and black balusters to a composite deck with lit post caps, made for evenings around a fire table. Tell us how you want to use your yard and we will plan the deck around it.

image.alt: Composite deck at dusk with lit post caps, white railings, outdoor sofas and a fire table

items.name: Attic stairs installation
items.blurb: A shaky pull-down ladder is a fall waiting to happen. We replace it with solid attic stairs that open and close smoothly. One customer says Andrew answered all her questions and concerns, cleaned up everything afterward, and she now has solid attic stairs.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a newly installed folding wooden attic ladder pulled down from a white hallway ceiling in a Northeastern American home, clean trim around the ceiling hatch, light gray painted walls, wood floor, soft daylight from a nearby window, tidy and finished, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: New folding wooden attic stairs lowered from a white hallway ceiling

items.name: Cabinet removal and tear-out
items.blurb: Getting ready to redo a room? We take out old cabinets and haul the mess away so the space is ready for what comes next. One family hired us to remove their old cabinets along with replacing their siding, and they recommend us for any home improvement project.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of an empty, swept-clean kitchen in a Northeastern American home after the old cabinets have been removed, bare walls with patched drywall, capped plumbing at the sink wall, a window with daylight, clean subfloor, ready for new cabinets, calm and orderly, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Empty, swept-clean kitchen with bare walls after old cabinets were removed

about.text: Houser Construction Company LLC is Andrew Houser's general contracting business. Andrew is the person you talk to on the phone, the one who looks at the problem and the one who answers reviews by name. One customer calls him an exceptional contractor: honest, communicative and affordable, with a keen eye for detail. His work runs from siding and structural repairs to decks, attic stairs and cabinet tear-outs. We are open seven days a week from 8 AM to 6 PM, so call when it suits you.

items.name: Thomas T.
items.text: Andrew did a fantastic job replacing rotten siding, sheathing and framing that the masons uncovered when demoing my front stoop.  I was in a bit of an emergency and he was there the next day.  I like that he explained in detail what needed to be done and even took extra measures to ensure the damage didn't happen again in the future.  An exceptional contractor with a keen attention to detail, honest, communicative, and affordable.  I'll be reaching out the next time I need any work done on the house. Thanks again!

items.name: m_zod 780
items.text: We had a great experience working with Andrew. He was professional, efficient, and did an excellent job replacing our house siding and removing old cabinets. Everything was completed on time and with great attention to detail. Highly recommend for any home improvement projects!

items.name: Kristine
items.text: Andrew was great to work with.  He responded to all my questions and concerns.  I have solid attic stairs now.   He cleaned up everything.  I’ve already asked him if he would help me with any upcoming projects.  I highly recommend Andrew Houser.

service_area.text: Our Google listing does not show a service area yet, so the simplest way to find out whether we cover your home is to call. Reach Andrew at (201) 317-4194, any day of the week from 8 AM to 6 PM. Tell him your town and what you need, whether that is new siding, a deck, attic stairs or a repair that cannot wait.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: We replace siding, repair rotted siding, sheathing and framing, build decks, install attic stairs and remove old cabinets. Our customers mention siding replacement and attic stairs installation most often in their Google reviews. If your project is not on this list, call Andrew and ask.

items.q: Can you come quickly if I find rot or damage?
items.a: We do our best. One homeowner was in a bit of an emergency after masons found rotten siding, sheathing and framing behind his front stoop, and Andrew was there the next day. Call (201) 317-4194 to tell us what you found.

items.q: Will you explain what needs fixing before you start?
items.a: Yes. Customers say Andrew explains in detail what needs to be done and answers every question and concern. On one repair he also took extra measures so the damage would not come back. You will know the plan before work begins.

items.q: Do you clean up when the job is done?
items.a: Yes. After installing new attic stairs, one customer says Andrew cleaned up everything. Another family says their siding replacement and cabinet removal were completed on time and with great attention to detail. Leaving your home tidy is part of the job.

We are open seven days a week, Monday through Sunday, from 8 AM to 6 PM. Call (201) 317-4194 to talk with Andrew about siding, a deck, attic stairs or a repair, or use the estimate request form on this page.

final_cta.h2: Found rot, or ready for new siding?
final_cta.text: Call Andrew Houser any day of the week to talk it through.
